builder = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec) spec.loader.exec_module(builder) t = time.monotonic() positive = out / 'positive.html' h = builder.build(root, builder.D_MANIFEST, builder.D_SRC, builder.D_CLAIMS, builder.D_PROTO, positive) assert h == pins[builder.D_OUT] fixture = out / 'fixture' fixture.mkdir(exist_ok=True) mapping = {} for label, path in [('design.md', builder.D_SRC), ('claims.json', builder.D_CLAIMS), ('prototype.html', builder.D_PROTO)]: data = Path(path).read_bytes() (fixture / label).write_bytes(data) mapping[label] = sha(data) def write_pins(): (fixture / 'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps({'sources': [{'path': k, 'rawSha256': v} for k, v in mapping.items()]}), encoding='utf-8') write_pins() target = fixture / 'output.html' target.write_bytes(b'REVIEW_SENTINEL') (fixture / 'design.md').write_bytes((fixture / 'design.md').read_bytes() + b'\nDRIFT') try: builder.build(fixture, 'manifest.json', 'design.md', 'claims.json', 'prototype.html', target) raise AssertionError('drift accepted') except builder.BuildError as exc: assert 'digest drift' in str(exc) assert target.read_bytes() == b'REVIEW_SENTINEL' payload = '& "' design = Path(builder.D_SRC).read_text(encoding='utf-8') design = re.sub(r'^- Narration: .*$', lambda _: '- Narration: ' + payload, design, count=1, flags=re.M) proto = scenes[0]['cards'] = [payload] proto = proto[:m.start(1)] + json.dumps(scenes, ensure_ascii=True) + proto[m.end(1):] for key, data in [('design.md', design.encode()), ('prototype.html', proto.encode())]: (fixture / key).write_bytes(data) mapping[key] = sha(data) write_pins() builder.build(fixture, 'manifest.json', 'design.md', 'claims.json', 'prototype.html', target) class
